designReferences.title: Feature based terrain generation using diffusion equation
designReferences.usedFor: Feature/elevation constraints, bounded smoothing; not a complete multigrid GPU implementation.

designReferences.title: Terrain Generation Using Procedural Models Based on Hydrology
designReferences.usedFor: Organized ridge/valley networks; not full geological erosion simulation.

designReferences.title: Procedural Generation of Roads
designReferences.usedFor: Slope/turn-aware route design; implemented as constrained ascent stages using the existing hex navigation.

behavior.worldSelection: Known mountain region cells resolve to one site; party walks to the reachable foot entry before entering.
behavior.terrain: Final user-selected style: flat-topped hex columns, 1m terrace levels, ridge/valley structure and controlled adjacent height changes. No continuous mountain shell is emitted.
behavior.ascent: Flat hex platforms; entry, four rising platforms, summit; 48m net gain; bidirectional path; no descent or cross-switchback shortcut.
behavior.legacy: Explicit v7 keeps original mountain terrain and area generation.
